description: Offline curated evidence catalog (rules + datasheet/profile placeholders).

items.title: Schema validity
items.excerpt: Design documents must include a non-empty id and satisfy the circuit IR schema.

items.title: Unique references
items.excerpt: Each component reference designator must be unique within a design.

items.title: Referenced pin existence
items.excerpt: Net endpoints must reference pins that exist on the named component.

items.title: Footprint presence
items.excerpt: Placement-bound functional classes (MCU, sensor, regulator, etc.) must declare a footprint_ref.

items.title: Output-to-output conflicts
items.excerpt: A net must not have more than one actively driven output endpoint.

items.title: Undriven required inputs
items.excerpt: Required input pins must attach to a net that has a modeled driver.

items.title: Power-input nets without a valid source
items.excerpt: Nets with power_in endpoints should connect to a modeled power_out source or be explicitly classed as power (e.g. board VIN).

items.title: Open-drain bus without required pull-up
items.excerpt: Open-drain and I2C buses require a passive pull-up to a power rail. See also component_profile / datasheet notes for bus devices.

items.title: Voltage-domain incompatibility
items.excerpt: Declared pin and net voltage_domain values on one net must agree (exact string equality).

items.title: Polarity-sensitive device orientation
items.excerpt: Polarized components (attributes.polarized) must not place the positive terminal on ground while the negative terminal is on a power rail.

items.title: I2C pull-up practice
items.excerpt: Typical I2C SDA/SCL buses use external resistors to VDD (often 2.2k–10k).

items.title: TMP117 datasheet (I2C open-drain)
items.excerpt: SDA and SCL are open-drain; external pull-ups to V+ are required.

items.title: AP2112K-3.3 LDO datasheet placeholder
items.excerpt: VOUT is the regulated output rail; local input/output capacitors recommended.

items.title: AP2112K-3.3 curated profile placeholder
items.excerpt: Curated LDO profile: power_out on VOUT, power_in on VIN, ground on GND.

items.title: Voltage domain labeling
items.excerpt: Use consistent labels (e.g. 3V3, 5V, GND) across pins and nets.

items.title: Polarized passive orientation
items.excerpt: Electrolytic/tantalum caps and diodes must match power/ground polarity.
